text: The proposed 30-day compliance window for Clause 7 is severely burdensome for seed-stage startups. We strongly suggest extending the transition period to at least 180 days.

While mandatory algorithmic audits are commendable, there is serious concern regarding the leakage of proprietary intellectual property. We recommend establishing independent certified audit frameworks.
We wholeheartedly welcome the requirement for a 48-hour acknowledgment of consumer complaints.

Clause 3 mandates strict local storage of all transaction metadata. This will exponentially escalate infrastructure costs for cloud-native firms. We recommend adopting a risk-based data categorization framework.
The proposed penalty of up to 4% of global turnover is disproportionately punitive. We advise introducing a statutory cure notice period of 45 days.
The draft text has been reviewed for general consultation regarding standard clause definitions.
Cross-border data flows are the backbone of SaaS industries. We recommend aligning cross-border adequacy rules with recognized international standards.
Local data storage is vital to protect citizen data. We fully support Clause 3 and recommend strict non-waivable penalties.
